extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the exact BZT52C18S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S electrical-characteristics table for manufacturer hongjiacheng.
The BZT52C18S row gives VZ minimum 16.8 V, nominal 18.0 V, and maximum 19.1 V at IZT = 5 mA; the nominal value and paired IZT are used for the zener breakdown fields.

The exact row gives maximum ZZT = 45 ohm at IZT = 5 mA, maximum ZZK = 225 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, reverse leakage IR = 0.1 microA at VR = 12.6 V, and admissible IZM = 5 mA. Zener impedance and admissible-current fields are not represented by the strict schema.

The forward-voltage maximum is 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA from the p. 1 maximum-ratings table. No component-specific capacitance value or reverse-recovery time is published; the p. 3 capacitance plot is a grouped series-level characteristic without a uniquely identified BZT52C18S trace.

The five zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C18S trace labeled 18 in p. 3 Fig. 2 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no points were interpolated.
